claims.highest_value_blocker: explicit framework/applicability + end-to-end error propagation, not a new harmonic label

claims.claim: One player responds to another player's motif.
claims.validated_scope: source separation/identity and motif correspondence are not production-ready

claims.claim: This passage feels more exciting because of feature X.
